crossRefs.note: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
“Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

translations.web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
translations.bsb: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
translations.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
translations.asv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; And I hate every false way.
